description:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

The Team and Your Impact

Hi, I'm Gio, and I lead People & Culture at Qdrant. I joined in April 2026 to build the People function from scratch. We have laid the foundations: went live with Ashby and with a new HRIS, launched our first engagement survey, a leveling framework, and our first review and compensation cycles are coming in 2027.

Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch.

You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you.

What you will own

About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. Your first year has four main areas:

  • AI-native People Ops

    • Use Claude and MCP frameworks every day to build agents and automations that take repetitive work off the team, starting with request triage and policy questions

    • Get the process and documentation right before you automate it, and decide what should stay human

    • Share what you learn, so the rest of the team picks up the same tools

  • People platforms, data, and analytics

    • Own our HRIS and people stack, including integrations, access, and data quality

    • Build people analytics and reporting, and work with me to turn the data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition and engagement trends to headcount planning

  • Global employment and payroll

    • Lead our move to a single global payroll provider, replacing today’s mix of US PEO, EOR, and local payroll setups with one platform, and make sure employment contracts, visas, and Finance coordination carry through the transition without gaps.

    • Design onboarding, mobility, and offboarding so they work the same way in every country

    • Be the go-to person for tricky cases like relocations, with external counsel behind you

  • Policies and benefits

    • Own our employee policies end to end, from drafting and legal review with counsel to rollout and upkeep

    • Design and launch a global benefits offering, country by country

    • Build a self-service documentation library, so people can find answers without asking

Who you are

  • You've spent 5 or more years in People Ops, HR operations, or People Systems, including time in a scaling, remote-first People function with EU and US presence

  • You've employed people in several countries across entities, EOR, and freelancers, with hands-on US and EU experience, and you know how to keep it compliant

  • You've worked with EOR, PEO, and global payroll platforms and can spot what looks off in payroll inputs before it goes out

  • You've owned an HRIS and people stack hands on, from setup to integrations and data quality, and you have real people analytics experience

  • You have strong Claude and Claude Code skills and use AI and MCP daily. You've built agents, skills, automations, or integrations that took real work off a team, ideally on HR or business systems. You know how to use AI with people data safely and in line with GDPR

  • You know your way around HR and automation tools: ideally Ashby and Leapsome (or HiBob, Greenhouse, or Personio), Deel or Remote, Jira, and n8n, Zapier, or Make

Nice to have

  • Comfort with APIs, webhooks, or light scripting

  • Knowledge of German or Spanish employment law, and a working grasp of US labor and employment rules

  • You have built a benefits offering across countries or consolidated EOR and payroll vendors

This role is probably not for you if you:

  • Need to be told what to fix first, or wait for a playbook before deciding

  • Want the process designed before you run it

  • Would rather someone else figure out the solution, and just implement it

  • Struggle with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and adapting as the market evolves, so priorities will shift

  • Prefer a quick call to writing things down, since we work async first

Interview process

  1. A 45-minute call with me (Gio). We talk about Qdrant, the role, and your background, and I am your point of contact throughout.

  2. A practical exercise: show us how you’d approach a real People Ops challenge

  3. Technical interviews:

    • A deeper conversation with me and the team (45 min)

    • A call with another colleague, so you get to know us too (30 min)

  4. A final call with one of our leaders.

I review every application myself after the application deadline, so take the time to tell us why you're a fit!

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.


Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!


For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy
